name: monero-bundle
description: Reproducible builder for the vendored Monero engine (repackages the pinned monero-ts npm artifact into the site's UMD moneroTs global + worker).

scripts.build: webpack --config webpack.config.js && cp node_modules/monero-ts/dist/monero.worker.js out/monero.worker.js && node -e "const p=require('monero-ts/package.json');console.log('built from monero-ts@'+p.version)"
scripts.vendor: npm run build && npm run verify && cp out/monero-engine.bundle.js out/monero.worker.js ../../vendor/ && echo 're-vendored -> testnetswap-site/vendor/ (now regen VENDOR.lock, and do a real browser tXMR->tBTC swap before shipping - see README)'
